bio: At the entrance to the small village of Medana, this family-run osteria wins hearts through its authenticity and its home-style cooking, which celebrates the typical recipes of the territory. The dishes – simple but full of flavour – are prepared with quality ingredients sourced from small local producers. Completing the experience are the wines of the Klinec estate, produced just a few steps from the osteria, which best express the spirit and flavours of the local area.
